references.purpose: Claim classes, constitutive and numerical evidence boundaries, uncertainty, physical and numerical controls, sensitivity, and model applicability.
read_when: selecting kinematics or a constitutive model
setting boundary/interface conditions or interpreting a continuum solution
claiming mesh/time convergence or material validity
references.evidence_boundary: Calibrates model formulation and numerical verification; it does not establish that constitutive parameters or a continuum idealization represent the physical material.
